title: Restricting a pushed-forward constant sheaf from one closed subset to another
statement: Let $X$ be a topological space, $Z,Z'\subseteq X$ closed subsets with inclusions $i:Z\to X$, $i':Z'\to X$, and $S$ a set. Let $\mathcal G=i'_*\underline S_{Z'}$ be the sheaf of sets on $X$ with $\mathcal G(V)=\{$locally constant maps $V\cap Z'\to S\}$ for $V\subseteq X$ open (restriction of maps as restriction), so $\Gamma(X,\mathcal G)$ is the set $\mathrm{LC}(Z',S)$ of locally constant maps $Z'\to S$. Let $\mathcal G|_Z=i^{-1}\mathcal G$ be the sheafification [def-weil-pbc-sheafification] $\theta:i_p\mathcal G\to\mathcal G|_Z$ of $i_p\mathcal G:U\mapsto\varinjlim_{V\supseteq U}\mathcal G(V)$ (colimit of sets [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit], coprojections $\iota^U_V$), as in [def-weil-pbc-topological-inverse-image] (2), (3) with values in sets. Then there is a bijection $\beta:\Gamma(Z,\mathcal G|_Z)\to\mathrm{LC}(Z\cap Z',S)$ such that $\beta(\theta_Z(\iota^Z_X(g)))=g|_{Z\cap Z'}$ for every $g\in\Gamma(X,\mathcal G)=\mathrm{LC}(Z',S)$. (For $Z'=X$: $\Gamma(Z,\underline S_X|_Z)\cong\mathrm{LC}(Z,S)$ compatibly with restriction of locally constant maps.)

proof.text: *Step 1 (the target sheaf $\mathcal H$ and the comparison map $\psi:i_p\mathcal G\to\mathcal H$).* On $Z$ let $\mathcal H(U)=\mathrm{LC}(U\cap Z',S)$ for $U\subseteq Z$ open, with restriction of maps; so $\mathcal H(Z)=\mathrm{LC}(Z\cap Z',S)$. $\mathcal H$ is a sheaf of sets: maps on the members of an open covering of $U\cap Z'$ that agree on overlaps glue to a unique map, and it is locally constant because local constancy is a local condition. For $U\subseteq Z$ open and $V\subseteq X$ open with $V\supseteq U$ put $\psi^U_V:\mathcal G(V)\to\mathcal H(U)$, $g\mapsto g|_{U\cap Z'}$ (defined since $U\cap Z'\subseteq V\cap Z'$; a restriction of a locally constant map is locally constant). For $V'\subseteq V$ both containing $U$, $\psi^U_{V'}(g|_{V'\cap Z'})=\psi^U_V(g)$, so the $\psi^U_V$ form a cocone on the diagram defining $i_p\mathcal G(U)=\varinjlim_{V\supseteq U}\mathcal G(V)$ [def-weil-pbc-topological-inverse-image] (2), and there is a unique map $\psi_U:i_p\mathcal G(U)\to\mathcal H(U)$ with $\psi_U\circ\iota^U_V=\psi^U_V$ [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]. For $U'\subseteq U$ open in $Z$ the two maps $\rho^{\mathcal H}_{U'U}\circ\psi_U$ and $\psi_{U'}\circ\rho^{i_p\mathcal G}_{U'U}$ agree on every $\iota^U_V(g)$ (both give $g|_{U'\cap Z'}$, since the restriction of $i_p\mathcal G$ sends $\iota^U_V$ to $\iota^{U'}_V$), and every element of $i_p\mathcal G(U)$ is such an $\iota^U_V(g)$ (the index set is directed) [lem-weil-pbc-filtered-colimit-sets-elementwise] (1); so $\psi:i_p\mathcal G\to\mathcal H$ is a morphism of presheaves of sets on $Z$.

proof.text: *Step 2 (definition of $\beta$ and the compatibility).* Since $\mathcal H$ is a sheaf, the universal property of the sheafification $\theta:i_p\mathcal G\to\mathcal G|_Z$ [def-weil-pbc-sheafification] gives a unique morphism of sheaves $\varphi:\mathcal G|_Z\to\mathcal H$ with $\varphi\circ\theta=\psi$. Put $\beta=\varphi_Z:\Gamma(Z,\mathcal G|_Z)\to\mathcal H(Z)=\mathrm{LC}(Z\cap Z',S)$. For $V\subseteq X$ open and $g\in\mathcal G(V)$ write $\eta_V(g)=\theta_{V\cap Z}(\iota^{V\cap Z}_V(g))\in(\mathcal G|_Z)(V\cap Z)$, the unit of $i^{-1}\dashv i_*$ [def-weil-pbc-topological-inverse-image] (3), a morphism of presheaves $\mathcal G\to i_*(\mathcal G|_Z)$, so $\eta_V(g)|_{V'\cap Z}=\eta_{V'}(g|_{V'\cap Z'})$ for $V'\subseteq V$. Then $(*)$ $\varphi_{V\cap Z}(\eta_V(g))=\psi_{V\cap Z}(\iota^{V\cap Z}_V(g))=g|_{V\cap Z\cap Z'}$. For $V=X$ this is the asserted compatibility $\beta(\theta_Z(\iota^Z_X(g)))=g|_{Z\cap Z'}$ for $g\in\Gamma(X,\mathcal G)=\mathrm{LC}(Z',S)$. It remains to show that $\beta$ is bijective (Steps 3-5).

Let $(\eta_V(g))_z$, $(\eta_{V'}(g'))_z$ have the same image under $\varphi_z$. By $(*)$, $(g|_{V\cap Z\cap Z'})_z=(g'|_{V'\cap Z\cap Z'})_z$ in $\mathcal H_z$, so by [lem-weil-pbc-filtered-colimit-sets-elementwise] (2) (open neighbourhoods of $z$ in $Z$ are the $W\cap Z$, $W\subseteq X$ open) there is an open $W

Then $\eta_V(g)|_{W'\cap Z}=\eta_{W'}(g|_{W'\cap Z'})=\eta_{W'}(g'|_{W'\cap Z'})=\eta_{V'}(g')|_{W'\cap Z}$ (Step 2), so $(\eta_V(g))_z=(\eta_{V'}(g'))_z$. Hence $\varphi_z$ is injective. proof.text: *Step 4 ($\varphi$ is injective on sections; $\beta$ is injective).* Let $U\subseteq Z$ be open and $t,t'\in(\mathcal G|_Z)(U)$ with $\varphi_U(t)=\varphi_U(t')$. For every $z\in U$, $\varphi_z(t_z)=(\varphi_U(t))_z=(\varphi_U(t'))_z=\varphi_z(t'_z)$, so $t_z=t'_z$ by Step 3. As $\mathcal G|_Z$ is a sheaf [def-weil-pbc-sheafification], $t=t'$ [lem-weil-pbc-sheaf-sections-determined-by-germs]. For $U=Z$: $\beta=\varphi_Z$ is injective.

*Step 5 ($ eta$ is surjective).* Let $h\in\mathrm{LC}(Z\cap Z',S)$. For each $z\in Z$ choose an open $W_z
i z$ of $X$ and $g^z\in\mathcal G(W_z)=\mathrm{LC}(W_z\cap Z',S)$ with $g^z|_{W_z\cap Z\cap Z'}=h|_{W_z\cap Z\cap Z'}$: if $z
otin Z'$, take $W_z=X\setminus Z'$ and $g^z$ the empty map (both sides are maps on $\emptyset$); if $z\in Z'$, $h$ is constant, say equal to $s$, on a neighbourhood of $z$ in $Z\cap Z'$, which contains one of the form $W_z\cap Z\cap Z'$ with $W_z
i z$ open in $X$; take $g^z$ the constant map $s$ on $W_z\cap Z'$. Put $U_z=W_z\cap Z$ and $t^z=\eta_{W_z}(g^z)\in(\mathcal G|_Z)(U_z)$; by $(*)$ of Step 2, $\varphi_{U_z}(t^z)=h|_{U_z\cap Z'}$. The $U_z$ cover $Z$. On $U_z\cap U_{z'}$, $\varphi(t^z|)=h|=\varphi(t^{z'}|)$ ($\varphi$ commutes with restrictions), so $t^z|_{U_z\cap U_{z'}}=t^{z'}|_{U_z\cap U_{z'}}$ by Step 4. Since $\mathcal G|_Z$ is a sheaf [def-weil-pbc-sheafification], the $t^z$ glue to $t\in\Gamma(Z,\mathcal G|_Z)$ with $t|_{U_z}=t^z$. Then $ eta(t)|_{U_z\cap Z'}=\varphi_{U_z}(t^z)=h|_{U_z\cap Z'}$ for all $z$, and the $U_z\cap Z'$ cover $Z\cap Z'$, so $ eta(t)=h$. With Step 4, $ eta$ is bijective, and Step 2 gives the compatibility; for $Z'=X$ this is $\Gamma(Z,\underline S_X|_Z)\cong\mathrm{LC}(Z,S)$ compatibly with restriction.
